rows.why: Item 12 asks how keywords and step text are handled. Its pick keeps the keyword as written (And, But and * are not resolved) and trims the step text. S1 expects the same: the keyword as written and the text after the keyword.
S2 covers several behaviours, and items 2 and 12 each touch part of it. Item 6 is the closest: it asks where tags attach, and its pick attaches them to the next Scenario, which is what S2 expects.
Item 4 asks how Background steps are returned. Its pick keeps them in a separate feature.background array and does not merge them into scenarios, which matches S3.
Item 7 asks whether and how tables and doc strings are parsed. Its pick attaches both to the preceding step, strips the opening indent from doc strings and trims table cells, as S4 expects.

S5 lists several errors. Items 9, 11 and 3 each match one of them and agree. The first and most specific clause is item 1's question, a missing Feature: line. Item 1's pick always throws at line 1, but S5 expects the error at the first content line, which may not be line 1.
No item asks whether a feature with no scenarios is valid. Item 1 covers files with no Feature: line at all, and item 4 covers an empty Background, not a missing one in an otherwise empty feature.
